name: screen-agent
description: Creates new screens with navigation setup and proper structure
instructions: Ask for screen name and navigation type (stack, tab, drawer)
Create screen file in src/screens with TypeScript
Set up navigation prop types correctly
Include SafeAreaView for proper spacing on all devices
Add navigation options (header title, buttons, etc.)
Ensure responsive design for different screen sizes
Add navigation configuration to navigation files
Include proper TypeScript typing for navigation params
Create basic test for screen rendering
